title: Aggrega Wasm CLI Socket
description: The JSON wire shape the cli.wasm plugin socket consumes (CLIRunInput). A CLI plugin extends the aggrega command-line tool's command surface: the host resolves a subcommand to a Wasm guest and hands it the invocation's argument vector; the guest executes and returns a process exit code as its integer return value. Standard output and standard error flow through host functions rather than a wire payload, so this socket declares an input shape only. The wire shape is generated into each ABI language from this schema, and per-language round-trip tests assert the three codecs produce one byte-identical wire.

CLIRunInput.description: The payload the host hands a CLI plugin on each invocation: the argument vector following the resolved subcommand name. The guest parses these tokens as its own flags and positional arguments, exactly as a standalone command-line program reads the arguments after its name.

args.description: The argument vector the guest receives, in invocation order — the tokens that follow the resolved subcommand name on the command line. Order is preserved so the payload is byte-identical across runs of identical input.
